description:
Preferred 
 • At least 3 years of hands-on development experience to produce high-quality Java J2EE /Rest API for the project following an Agile development approach. 
 • At least 2 years of experience working on java frameworks like Spring, Struts etc. 
 • At least 2 years of experience developing and optimize Oracle routines. 
 • ability to finalize requirements documents by participating in requirements reviews and sign-off sessions to confirm understanding and validate business requirements. Use validated requirements to design core software components. 
 • Ability to develop written test cases as well as automated software test cases to validate requirements. A submitted automated software test cases with each software deliverable. 
 • Ability to develop to work in a team to integrate the core infrastructure and transaction web applications with the core workflow and configuration components. 
 • Willingness to learn and work on any new technology
 • Excellent stakeholder management skills
 • Exposure to working in Agile environment
 • Ability to work in team environment and client interfacing skills.
 • Good Communication and Analytical Skills 
 

 


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
